question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Consonance of sounds.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Consonance"** means the agreement or compatibility between opinions or actions; in the context of sounds, it refers to the harmony and pleasant combination of notes. (संगति, मेल)

 
 
• **Example:** The** consonance** of their voices created a beautiful harmony.
 
 
 
• **"Symphony"** refers to an elaborate musical composition for a full orchestra, typically in four movements, at least one of which is traditionally in sonata form.
 
• It also denotes** a harmonious combination of elements. (**संगीत रचना)
 
• **Example:** Beethoven's Ninth **Symphony** is renowned for its complexity and beauty.
 
• Hence, we can infer that **"Symphony"** is a one-word substitute for** "Consonance of sounds."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Troupe** (मंडली): A group of dancers, actors, or other entertainers who tour to different venues.

 
 
• **Example:** The** troupe** performed a dazzling show that captivated the audience.
 
 
 
• **Woodwinds** (वूडविंड्स): A family of musical instruments within the more general category of wind instruments, which includes flutes, clarinets, oboes, and bassoons.
 
 
• **Example:** The** woodwinds **section added a delicate texture to the orchestral performance.
 
 
 
• **Orchestration** (वाद्यवृंद): The arrangement of a musical composition for performance by an orchestra or other ensemble.
 
 
• **Example:** The **orchestration **of the piece was complex and required a large ensemble.
